description: Build the stdlib-only Python auto-tuner package under automation/tuner/ plus its unittest suite. This is the core, fully in-sandbox-testable deliverable: scoring, parameter space with ordering constraints, local-search + rule-based nudge optimizer, persistent restart-safe state, and a robust GaganEA.mq5 input-rewriter. One invocation = ingest last report -> update state/best -> propose next params -> write them into GaganEA.mq5 -> exit (idempotent per invocation; the LOOP is done by orchestration in FEAT-003).
steps: Create automation/tuner/ package. Suggested layout: automation/tuner/scoring.py, automation/tuner/params.py, automation/tuner/mq5_rewriter.py, automation/tuner/state.py, automation/tuner/tuner.py (CLI entry: python3 automation/tuner/tuner.py ...), and automation/tuner/tests/ (or test_*.py alongside). Keep it clean and stdlib-only (no pip, no third-party imports).

SCORING (scoring.py): implement ONE clearly-documented, easily-editable score(metrics) function. Rule (authoritative): maximize NET PROFIT subject to a HARD relative-drawdown ceiling of 15%. Any candidate with relative DD > 15% must score strictly worse than ANY candidate with DD <= 15% (implement via a large penalty proportional to the overage, or a two-tier score where the DD>15% tier is always below the DD<=15% tier). Among DD<=15% candidates prefer higher net profit, then higher profit factor as tiebreaker. Lightly penalize degenerate cases: fewer than 30 trades = statistically meaningless (apply a penalty). Read relative DD from metrics['relative_drawdown_pct'], net profit from metrics['total_net_profit'], PF from metrics['profit_factor'], trade count from metrics['total_trades']. Handle missing/None metrics defensively (treat as worst-case). Document the 15% constant as a named, editable module constant.

PARAM SPACE (params.py): define the TUNABLE space explicitly as a list/dict of parameters, each with min/max/step, mapped to the exact GaganEA.mq5 input name. Include: Risk_Percent (0.25..2.0), Min_EMA_Distance, Min_Trade_Distance, StopLoss_Pips, T1_Pips, T2_Pips, T3_Pips, T1_ClosePercent, T2_ClosePercent, Entry_Cooldown_Bars, Max_Concurrent_Positions. Use sensible bounds/steps grounded in the current v2.11 defaults (Risk_Percent=1.0, Min_EMA_Distance=400, Min_Trade_Distance=500, StopLoss_Pips=1000, T1=500,T2=1000,T3=1800, T1_ClosePercent=33.0, T2_ClosePercent=50.0, Entry_Cooldown_Bars=3, Max_Concurrent_Positions=2). Implement validity/ordering enforcement: enforce T1_Pips < T2_Pips < T3_Pips <= StopLoss_Pips, clamp all params to [min,max] and snap to step, and keep int params int / double params float. Provide a function that takes a proposed param vector and returns a VALID param vector (clamped + ordering-repaired) so the tuner NEVER writes an invalid EA. Preserve each param's numeric type so the rewriter emits the same literal style (int vs double).

MQL5 REWRITER (mq5_rewriter.py): implement a function that, given a path to GaganEA.mq5 (or file text) and a dict of {input_name: new_value}, rewrites ONLY the literal on the matching `input <type> <Name> = <value>;` line for each named input, matched by EXACT input name (word-boundary), preserving all surrounding whitespace, alignment, and any trailing `// comment`. Use a conservative per-line regex like `^(\s*input\s+\S+\s+NAME\s*=\s*)([^;]+)(;.*)$`. Must: round-trip safely (rewriting with the same values yields byte-identical file), change ONLY the targeted literal, format ints as ints and doubles with a decimal (match existing style, e.g. 1.0 not 1), and raise/return an explicit error for a missing input name (do NOT silently corrupt or append). Never touch lines that merely contain the name as a substring of another identifier. Also expose a helper to READ current values of the tunable inputs from GaganEA.mq5 so the tuner can seed its state from the live file.

STATE (state.py): persistent restart-safe JSON at automation/tuner/tuner_state.json (tracked). Schema must include: current param vector, the BEST-scoring param vector + its metrics + its score, iteration count, and a history log (list of per-iteration records: iteration, params delta, resulting metrics summary, score, accepted bool, best-so-far score). Load-or-init: if the file is missing/empty/corrupt, initialize from the current GaganEA.mq5 input values (via the rewriter's reader) with no best yet. Write atomically (write temp then replace) so a killed process cannot corrupt it.

OPTIMIZER + CLI (tuner.py): implement one idempotent invocation that: (1) locates the latest backtest report/summary (accept a --summary-json or --report path arg, or default to reading the newest reports/tuner/*.summary.json; reuse tools/analyze_report.py: import analyze_file to parse a raw .html, OR just json.load an existing .summary.json - do NOT reimplement parsing), (2) scores the CURRENT param set's metrics, updates state: if better than best, record new best; append a history record with the accept/reject decision, (3) proposes the NEXT param vector using a simple robust LOCAL SEARCH (hill-climb / coordinate descent / 1-param-at-a-time perturbation with accept-if-better, keep-best) plus a RULE-BASED NUDGE layer aligned to the diagnosis: DD>15% -> reduce Risk_Percent and/or widen Min_* distances; overtrading (very high trade count) -> widen Min_EMA_Distance/Min_Trade_Distance and raise Entry_Cooldown_Bars; PF<1 -> adjust SL/target ratio (e.g. tighten SL toward targets or shift targets). Make moves deterministic-ish and explainable (seedable RNG or pure coordinate descent). (4) validate the proposed vector through params.py, (5) write it into GaganEA.mq5 via the rewriter, and write a human-readable per-iteration log line (param delta + resulting score + accepted? + current best) to a log file under automation/tuner/ (git-ignored logs dir) and/or stdout. Also update a version/param marker so the running build is identifiable: write the current param set into a comment or a small tracked file (e.g. automation/tuner/current_params.json) and/or bump a sub-version marker - choose a safe, non-corrupting mechanism (a tracked JSON is safest; if bumping the mq5 header comment, do it via the same conservative line-based edit). CLI flags to support: --summary-json/--report (input), --state (state path), --mq5 (GaganEA.mq5 path), --dry-run (compute + log but do NOT write mq5/state), --reset (reinitialize state from current mq5). Exit non-zero only on real errors; a 'nothing changed' proposal logs and exits 0.

TESTS (stdlib unittest, all runnable in-sandbox, no MT5 dependency): (a) scoring - DD>15% ALWAYS ranks below any DD<=15% candidate (assert score ordering across crafted metric dicts); net-profit ordering among DD<=15% candidates; PF tiebreaker; low-trade (<30) penalty; missing-metric defensiveness. (b) params - clamping to bounds, step snapping, and ordering enforcement never emits T1>=T2 or T2>=T3 or T3>StopLoss (feed deliberately invalid vectors and assert repaired output is valid); int/double type preservation. (c) rewriter - use a SMALL fixture .mq5 snippet (a few input lines with varied whitespace + a trailing comment), NOT the whole EA: round-trips byte-identical when rewritten with same values; changes ONLY the targeted literal (other lines untouched); double stays double / int stays int; a missing input name is handled explicitly (raises or returns an error, does not corrupt); a name that is a substring of another identifier is NOT clobbered. (d) state - init-from-mq5 when file absent; best-tracking updates only on improvement; atomic write leaves valid JSON; history append. Keep fixtures inline or under automation/tuner/tests/fixtures/.

Do a SAMPLE rewrite of the real GaganEA.mq5 (e.g. via --dry-run comparison or a scratch copy) and read through the affected input lines to confirm the file still looks like valid, compilable MQL5 (correct `input TYPE Name = value;` syntax, semicolons intact, comments preserved). Do NOT leave GaganEA.mq5 modified by this test step - restore it to the committed state (git checkout GaganEA.mq5) after the read-through so FEAT-003 and the orchestrator see a clean baseline, OR leave a single intentional param change if that is the natural first-iteration output (document which). Prefer leaving GaganEA.mq5 unchanged at the end of this feature.
acceptance_criteria: automation/tuner/ contains stdlib-only Python: scoring, params, rewriter, state, tuner CLI, and tests. No third-party imports.
python3 -m py_compile succeeds on every new .py file.

The scoring function is a single documented function with the 15% ceiling as a named editable constant; tests prove DD>15% always ranks below DD<=15%, net-profit ordering, PF tiebreaker, and the <30-trade penalty.
Param validation always returns a valid vector: T1<T2<T3<=StopLoss, all clamped to bounds and snapped to step, types preserved; tests prove invalid inputs are repaired.

The rewriter round-trips byte-identical on same-value rewrite, changes only the targeted literal, preserves int/double style and comments, and handles a missing input name explicitly; proven by tests on a small fixture.
State is restart-safe: init-from-mq5 on missing file, atomic write, best-tracking + history; proven by tests.
One tuner invocation is idempotent (ingest -> update -> propose -> write mq5 -> exit) and supports --dry-run and --reset.
A sample rewrite of the real GaganEA.mq5 read-through confirms it remains syntactically valid MQL5; GaganEA.mq5 is left in a clean/known state.
All touched files are pure ASCII (grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' empty).
verification: python3 -m py_compile automation/tuner/*.py (and any tests dir) exits 0.
python3 -m unittest for the new tuner test module(s) passes with all tests green.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' still passes all 16 existing analyzer tests (no regression).
grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' over all new/changed .py files and GaganEA.mq5 returns nothing.
Read-through of the tunable input lines in GaganEA.mq5 after a sample rewrite confirms valid `input TYPE Name = value;` syntax.

file_layout.automation/tuner/scoring.py: single documented score(metrics). Two-tier: compliant (relative_drawdown_pct <= MAX_RELATIVE_DD_PCT) = TIER_A_OFFSET(1e9)+net_profit + tiny PF tiebreaker (PF_TIEBREAK_WEIGHT=1e-3) - low-trade penalty (LOW_TRADE_PENALTY_PER_TRADE=50 per trade under MIN_MEANINGFUL_TRADES=30). Over-ceiling = TIER_SEPARATOR(0)-overage, always <= 0 so ALWAYS below any compliant score. Missing/None metrics coerced to worst-case (_WORST_NET_PROFIT=-1e6 kept well within TIER_A_OFFSET so tiers never overlap; missing DD -> worst-case DD -> lands in over-ceiling tier). Editable ceiling constant MAX_RELATIVE_DD_PCT=15.0.
file_layout.automation/tuner/params.py: PARAM_LIST of 11 Param(name,min,max,step,ptype,default) mapped to exact mq5 names (Risk_Percent 0.25..2.0 double; Min_EMA_Distance 100..1200; Min_Trade_Distance 100..1500; StopLoss_Pips 400..3000; T1_Pips 100..2000; T2_Pips 200..2500; T3_Pips 300..3000; T1_ClosePercent/T2_ClosePercent 10..90 double; Entry_Cooldown_Bars 0..20; Max_Concurrent_Positions 1..5). validate(proposed) clamps+snaps+type-coerces then repairs ordering T1_Pips<T2_Pips<T3_Pips<=StopLoss_Pips (raises StopLoss to fit, else pulls chain down); is_valid() checks bounds+ordering; defaults() returns typed v2.11 vector.
file_layout.automation/tuner/mq5_rewriter.py: per-line regex ^(\s*input\s+\S+\s+NAME\s*=\s*)([^;]*?)(\s*;.*)$ matched by exact name via re.escape (word-boundary safe, substring names NOT clobbered). rewrite_text/rewrite_file replace only the literal, preserve whitespace/alignment/trailing comment, byte-identical on same-value rewrite, int stays int / double keeps a decimal (e.g. 2 -> 2.0). Missing name raises MissingInputError BEFORE writing (no corruption). read_values/read_current_vector/read_file_vector extract live values (defaulted).
file_layout.automation/tuner/state.py: load_or_init (init-from-mq5 on missing/empty/corrupt; init reads LIVE file values as-is with NO ordering repair so state reflects the compiled EA; repair happens later at propose/write time). save() atomic via tempfile.mkstemp + fsync + os.replace. record_iteration bumps iteration, updates best only when accepted, appends history record (iteration, params, metrics_summary, score, accepted, best_score). compute_delta/metrics_summary helpers.
file_layout.automation/tuner/tuner.py: idempotent CLI. Dual import (relative for -m, flat for direct script). load_metrics from --summary-json OR --report (lazy import of tools/analyze_report.analyze_file, tolerates its absence) OR newest reports/tuner/*.summary.json. Scores current metrics, updates best/history, propose_next = start from best-or-current -> rule_based_nudges (DD>15% cut Risk_Percent+widen Min_* ; overtrading>400 widen Min_*+raise cooldown ; PF<1 tighten StopLoss+lower T1) -> deterministic coordinate-descent 1-step -> params.validate. Writes GaganEA.mq5 via rewriter, atomic state, current_params.json marker, logs/tuner.log + stdout line. Flags: --summary-json/--report/--state/--mq5/--dry-run/--reset. Exit non-zero only on real errors (missing mq5=2, report load fail=3, rewrite MissingInputError=4); no-op/no-report/no-change exit 0.
file_layout.automation/tuner/tests/: _bootstrap.py inserts the tuner package dir onto sys.path (mirrors tools/ convention). test_scoring.py (8), test_params.py (10), test_rewriter.py (9 - inline small fixture, not the whole EA), test_state.py (6). __init__.py present.
file_layout.automation/tuner/current_params.json: tracked marker seeded to the live v2.11 EA vector (Risk_Percent 1.0, StopLoss_Pips 1000, T3_Pips 1800, etc.).
file_layout.automation/tuner/tuner_state.json: tracked initial state seeded from GaganEA.mq5 (iteration 0, best null, current = live EA vector).
file_layout..gitignore: added automation/tuner/logs/ (per-iteration logs ignored; tuner_state.json and current_params.json stay tracked).

test_commands.tuner_tests_WORKING: from automation/tuner/: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'` -> Ran 33 tests, OK. (Run from the tuner dir; the tests use `from tests import _bootstrap` which adds the package dir to sys.path so `import scoring/params/...` resolve. Running discover with -s automation/tuner/tests from repo root does NOT work because the start dir differs - matches the FEAT-001 discover gotcha.)
test_commands.analyzer_regression: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py'` from repo root -> Ran 16 tests, OK (no regression).
test_commands.cli_smoke: `python3 automation/tuner/tuner.py --summary-json reports/samples/sample_report.summary.json --dry-run` and `python3 -m automation.tuner.tuner ... --dry-run` both exit 0; dry-run writes NO files.

findings.test_counts: 33 new tuner tests (8 scoring + 10 params + 9 rewriter + 6 state) all green; 16 existing analyzer tests still green. Total 49 green.
findings.ascii_status: grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' over all new .py files, both tracked JSON markers, and .gitignore returns nothing (exit 1 = clean). Pure ASCII, no em dashes. (__pycache__/*.pyc are gitignored binaries, not part of the deliverable.)
findings.gaganea_unchanged: CONFIRMED. Sample rewrite was done on a scratch copy under a temporary .scratch/ dir (since diff is unavailable and /tmp did not persist across shell invocations). The scratch rewrite produced valid MQL5: `input double Risk_Percent = 0.75;` (decimal preserved), `input int StopLoss_Pips = 1800;` (int, raised from 1000 by the T3<=StopLoss ordering repair since the shipped EA has T3_Pips=1800 > StopLoss_Pips=1000), T1/T2/T3 strictly increasing, semicolons + alignment + trailing comments intact, non-targeted lines untouched. Scratch dir removed. `git status --short GaganEA.mq5` is empty (unchanged).
notable_decisions: The shipped v2.11 EA has T3_Pips=1800 > StopLoss_Pips=1000, which VIOLATES the spec ordering rule T1<T2<T3<=StopLoss. Decision: state.init_from_mq5 records the RAW live values (so state truthfully reflects the compiled EA), and ordering repair (which raises StopLoss to >=1800) is applied only by params.validate when a NEXT vector is proposed/written. This keeps the EA valid on every write without silently mutating the recorded baseline.
TIER_A_OFFSET set to 1e9 (not 1e13) and worst-case net-profit fallback to -1e6 so the 1e-3 PF tiebreaker survives float64 precision while tiers still never overlap.
current_params.json and tuner_state.json seeded to the true live EA vector (not a stale test-run artifact) so the committed baseline is a clean known state.
findings.sandbox_limits: In-sandbox only: NO MQL5 compiler / MT5 / PowerShell, so EA compile and Strategy Tester runs remain UNVERIFIABLE here; syntax of rewritten inputs was validated by conservative read-through only. FEAT-003 (PowerShell/BAT orchestration, README, ITERATION_LOG) intentionally NOT touched. No commit/push performed (orchestrator commits to main).

review_fixes_2026-09-13-131052.issue1_first_write_stoploss_side_effect: FIXED (transparency; scoring/validation semantics UNCHANGED). Done both nice-to-have (a) and required (b). (a) tuner.py: propose_next now also returns repair_names (via new _ordering_repair_names(pre_validate, post_validate) comparing the pre-validate proposal to params.validate's output), and appends an 'ordering/bounds repair (not a nudge): ...' note when validate had to change a value. run() splits the logged delta into delta= (nudge/coordinate-step moves) and repair_delta= (values changed only for bounds/step/ordering legality), so the first-write StopLoss_Pips 1000->1800 raise that satisfies T3<=StopLoss on the seeded-invalid v2.11 vector is now distinct from an intentional nudge. Verified via dry-run: delta shows the risk/distance nudges, repair_delta shows {StopLoss_Pips:[1000,1800]}. (b) automation/tuner/README.md gained a 'First run note: the opening move widens the stop' section explaining the seeded-invalid ordering and the 80%-wider stop on iteration 1, and how to keep the 1000 stop (lower T3_Pips before first run) if desired.
review_fixes_2026-09-13-131052.issue3_pf_tiebreaker_headroom: FIXED (regression guard; scoring semantics UNCHANGED - the existing constants already pass, so no margin change was warranted). Added tests/test_scoring.py::test_pf_tiebreaker_smallest_delta_headroom asserting two compliant candidates with EQUAL net profit + trades but a PF gap of 0.001 (1.500 vs 1.501) produce strictly distinguishable scores (higher PF strictly higher, not equal) on top of TIER_A_OFFSET=1e9. Added a FLOAT-HEADROOM CONSTRAINT comment near PF_TIEBREAK_WEIGHT in scoring.py documenting the offset*2**-52 resolution constraint. Tuner suite now 34 green.
review_fixes_2026-09-13-131052.verification: python3 -m py_compile automation/tuner/*.py automation/tuner/tests/*.py OK; from automation/tuner: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -> Ran 34, OK; analyzer 16 green; grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' over scoring.py/tuner.py/test_scoring.py/README.md returns nothing; no em dashes; GaganEA.mq5 unchanged.

review_fixes_2026-09-13-132111_v2.issue1_collision_misclassification: FIXED (transparency/accuracy only; scoring/validation semantics and the value written to GaganEA.mq5 UNCHANGED). tuner.py: replaced _ordering_repair_names (binary: did validate change it) with _classify_changes(base, stepped, valid) which compares all THREE snapshots and splits every validate-changed param into two ORIGIN buckets: repair_only (validate changed it AND no nudge/step touched it, i.e. stepped==base) vs collision (a nudge/step moved it AND validate then overrode that move, i.e. stepped!=base and valid!=stepped). propose_next now returns (valid, notes, repair_names, repair_only, collision) where repair_names = repair_only|collision (still used to route repair_delta in run()). Notes wording: 'ordering/bounds repair (not a nudge): <repair_only>' is now reserved for PURE-repair params only, and a new 'repair overrode nudge: <collision>' note is emitted for collision params so the log never asserts 'not a nudge' for a param a nudge targeted. run() unpacks the 5-tuple; a collision param keeps its full old->final move in repair_delta (final written value is what matters) but is described honestly in notes. Verified by dry-run: real v2.11 baseline (round01, PF 0.58, pf<1 fires) shows repair_delta={StopLoss_Pips:[1000,1800]} with note 'repair overrode nudge: StopLoss_Pips'; sample_report (PF>=1, pf<1 does NOT fire) shows the same StopLoss raise but note 'ordering/bounds repair (not a nudge): StopLoss_Pips' (correctly pure-repair). README.md 'First run note: the opening move widens the stop' section rewritten to describe the two-step story on the real baseline (pf<1 nudge tightens StopLoss 1000->900, then ordering-repair raises it to 1800 to satisfy T3<=StopLoss, repair overrides the nudge, net 1000->1800 write) and to note the 'not a nudge' wording is reserved for the PF>=1 pure-repair case; no longer asserts a pure legality repair in the pf<1 scenario.
review_fixes_2026-09-13-132111_v2.issue2_delta_split_untested: FIXED. Added automation/tuner/tests/test_delta_split.py (4 tests, uses the `from tests import _bootstrap` sys.path pattern) exercising the composed propose_next->validate classification: (a) test_collision_stoploss_nudged_then_repaired builds the seeded-invalid v2.11 base (T3_Pips=1800, StopLoss_Pips=1000, other v2.11 defaults) with pf<1 metrics (profit_factor 0.58, relative_drawdown_pct 28.36, total_trades 1012), asserts StopLoss_Pips is in repair_names AND in collision (not repair_only), valid['StopLoss_Pips']==1800, notes contain 'repair overrode nudge: StopLoss_Pips' and NOT 'not a nudge): StopLoss_Pips', and the pf<1 note is still present; (b) test_pure_repair_no_nudge_touched uses benign metrics (no rule fires) so only the coordinate step (iteration 0 -> Risk_Percent) moves a param and StopLoss is a pure repair, asserting StopLoss_Pips in repair_only, not collision, with the 'not a nudge' note; (c) test_pure_nudge_not_in_repair_names uses a legal start (T3=900<=StopLoss) + dd>15 to nudge Risk_Percent down to 0.75 (iteration 9 so the coordinate step targets Entry_Cooldown_Bars, not Risk_Percent) and asserts Risk_Percent is NOT in repair_names/repair_only/collision; (d) test_repair_names_is_union_of_buckets asserts repair_only and collision are disjoint and their union equals repair_names. These lock the collision-vs-pure-repair classification so the misclassification the v2 review flagged is now caught by CI.
